item.title: In the Shadow of the Bridge
item.description: Photographer Dick Evans and award-winning writer Hannah Hindley explore Bay Area birds and the conservation dilemmas they face.

item.title: Butterflies of the Bay Area and (Slightly) Beyond
item.description: Self-taught butterfly obsessive Liam O’Brien shares his passion for these beloved and storied insects in this informative and surprisingly personal guidebook

item.title: California Rewritten
item.description: Knopf Editor John Freeman proposes a contemporary California literary canon for the 21st century.

item.title: The ABCs of California's Native Bees
item.description: National Geographic Explorer profiles California's native bees from A to Z in new image-rich guidebook.

item.title: Ocean Beach: Fog, Fauna, and Flora
item.description: Scientist and surfer Eddy Rubin celebrates the inhabitants and phenomena that shape this dynamic coastal ecosystem perched at land’s end.

item.title: In Memoriam, Heyday Remembers Malcolm Margolin
item.description: The passing of our founder and dear friend Malcolm leaves all of us at Heyday redoubled in our commitment to the work he began here fifty years ago.

item.title: Birds of Santa Cruz
item.description: From Santa Cruz-born artist and activist Sophie Wood Brinker comes a gorgeously illustrated guide to the birds of Santa Cruz—and a testament to the power of attention.

item.title: I Love Salmon and Lampreys
item.description: For young readers, an inspiring story about a river, a successful Native-led movement for environmental justice, and the making of a scientist.

item.title: Co-editors of Loam Center Carework and Mutual Aid in this Practical Guide to Navigating Our Changing Climate
item.description: Kate Rose Weiner and Kailea Rose Loften draw on the experiences of organizers and first responders to offer a one-of-a-kind resource for tending to our communities, bodies, and spirits when disaster strikes.

item.title: Alice Piper Speaks Up
item.description: New richly illustrated book for middle grade readers chronicles the pathbreaking Native American student who desegregated California schools.

item.title: The Enduring Wild
item.description: Forgotten Lands project founder Josh Jackson advocates for enhanced conservation of BLM public lands
